find: if (typeof expected !== 'number' || typeof actual !== 'number') return expected === actual;
replace: if (typeof expected !== 'number' || typeof actual !== 'number') return true;
killedBy: the screen baseline: how far a box may move between platforms (issue #861) compares non-numeric box values exactly, rather than calling them near enough
why: Makes a missing box compare equal to a present one. The tolerance is arithmetic on two numbers; the moment either side is `undefined` -- a selector that stopped being measured, a malformed entry -- there is nothing to take a difference of, and returning true reports agreement between a box and no box at all. That is the opposite of what the tolerance was widened for: it exists to absorb a glyph advance landing either side of a rounding boundary, not to excuse a control that disappeared.
